label: Second copy step (outputting original token 1) in long sequences (L >= 8)
explanation: Fires almost exclusively in the copy phase (99.6% of mass), right after <DEL>: mainly at recall_idx 1 (input = fed-back first original token, prev_tok = <DEL>; 84% of mass), with a weaker tail at recall_idx 2 (16%) and almost nothing at the delimiter step or later. Strongly length-dependent: never fires for L <= 5, L = 9 holds 74% of mass and L = 8 another 23%. Never fires during the original phase. Within that window it is only selective in part (precision ~0.29): rate and magnitude depend on the identity of the first original token (input at that step), highest for u, then v, e, p, k; restricting to a set of ~11 such first tokens raises F1 only to 0.48, so token identity modulates it diffusely rather than defining it. Top activations are L = 9 sequences starting with u. Including recall_idx 2 raises mass recall to 0.96 but halves precision.
